# Banner

Made with ComfyUI, Z-Image Turbo (1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1), seed 22, workflow in `banner.workflow.json`.

Prompt: wide cinematic view of a procedurally generated spiral galaxy seen from above, glowing blue and gold spiral arms, a few highlighted star systems connected by thin cyan lines like a star map, small orbit rings around one bright star with planets, deep space background, digital art, clean, no text, no logos

`social-preview.jpg` is the centre 1280x640 crop for the repository's social preview (Settings, UI only).
